justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/ThreadUtils.java and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/ThreadUtilsTest.java. ThreadPredicate is a small nested functional interface with only two production overloads that accept it (findThreads(ThreadGroup, boolean, ThreadPredicate) and findThreads(ThreadPredicate)) and a few in-file implementations/helpers (AlwaysTruePredicate, NamePredicate, ThreadIdPredicate); rg found no other production classes referencing it, only the test import and one null-argument test. That is low fan-in/fan-out, not a dependency hub.
